failedAssertions.reason: Re-run confirmed: semantic formatting tags (<strong>, <em>, <u>, <mark>) in newsletter body are NOT converted to inline-styled <span> elements. The convertTipTapToInlineHTML() function in src/lib/promotion-email-html.ts only converts block-level elements (h2, h3, p, ul, li, a) but passes through inline formatting elements unchanged. The fix feature 'fix-semantic-tags-to-inline-styles' has not been implemented yet (status: pending).
